title: Crunchyhroll to Stream Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Anime's English Dub on November 12
content: Crunchyroll announced on Thursday that it will begin exclusively streaming the English, Spanish, and Portuguese dubs for the Dragon Ball Super: Beerus television anime series on November 12 at 11:00 a.m. EST. New dubbed episodes will premiere weekly.
author: ANN

title: Titan Manga Licenses Kuruno Loves the Occult!, Dominating at the Academy of Returned Heroes, More Manga
content: Titan Manga announced on Thursday that it has licensed the following manga for release in summer 2027: When high-school student Yuuki is contacted online by the mysterious Kuruno, he finds himself dragged into a series of increasingly strange expeditions to investigate the supernatural.
author: ANN

title: Good Smile Company Partially Reopens on November 6 Following Data Breach of Online Store
content: The company also revealed that it has restored the online store to its state before the unauthorized access from a backup. It has also repaired vulnerabilities in its administration system and strengthened its procedures in order to prevent recurrence.
author: ANN

title: Lycoris Recoil: Friends are thieves of time. Anime Short Films Get Manga Adaptation
content: The six-episode shorts debuted on Aniplex 's official YouTube channel in April 2025. The shorts also streamed on Aniplex USA 's YouTube channel, and on Crunchyroll . The shorts center on the daily lives of the characters at Café LycoReco.
author: ANN

title: The Dangers in My Heart Season 3 Anime's Teaser Trailer Reveals April 2027 Premiere
content: The official website for the anime of Norio Sakurai 's The Dangers in My Heart ( Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu ) manga revealed on Friday a teaser promotional video, visual, and April 2027 premiere for the third season . A compilation film titled The Dangers in My Heart: The Movie opened in Japan on February 13.
author: ANN

title: The Dangers in My Heart (BokuYaba) Season 3 New Visual and Trailer Revealed, April 2027 Release
content: The Dangers in My Heart (BokuYaba) Season 3 revealed a key visual and trailer, along with an April 2027 release date. Studio Shin-Ei is again in charge of the animation production. You can watch the new trailer below.
author: Anime Corner

title: OceanVeil Streams English Dub of Even the Student Council Has It's Holes! Anime
content: OceanVeil started streaming the English dub for the television anime of Muchimaro 's Even the Student Council Has Its Holes! ( Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru! ) four-panel manga on October 31. OceanVeil is simultaneously streaming the English dub of the anime's "on air" version and its "unrestricted" version.
author: ANN

title: Shonen Jump’s Next Surprise Live-Action Movie Casts Netflix’s One Piece Zoro as Its Hero – Watch Trailer
content: Mackenyu, Netflix’s One Piece Zoro, will lead Shonen Jump ‘s next live-action adaptation, and it’s perfect casting. title: MAGES. Works on New Girls und Panzer Console Game
content: The official website of the Girls und Panzer das Finale film series reported on October 30 that a "new consumer game" by MAGES will be announced at the " Girls und Panzer Mini Mini Hobby Show" during the "Oarai Ankō Matsuri 2026" event on November 14.
author: ANN

title: A Few Moments of Cheers' Studio Hurray! Animates Wondering Mate Net Shorts
content: Hurray! , one of the animation studios for A Few Moments of Cheers film, is planning and animating Wondering Mate , an original short anime that will premiere on Meta Taxi's YouTube channel on December 16.
author: ANN
